subject: Hospitality
title: The Atrium Hotel Revolution
description: One-minute skill: The Atrium Hotel Revolution.

hook.text: John Portman's 1967 Hyatt Regency Atlanta featured a 22-story open atrium that stunned the hotel industry.

buildup.text: The atrium lobby—soaring open space with glass elevators and interior balconies.

discovery.text: Portman designed hotels where architecture was the experience. The building was not a container for rooms—it was the attraction.

twist.text: Critics called it wasteful—all that empty space could have been revenue-generating rooms.

climax.text: Portman's atrium design influenced hotel architecture worldwide. Soaring lobbies became a standard feature of convention hotels.

punchline.text: 22 stories of pure empty space. Portman proved that nothing can be everything.

quiz.question: What was revolutionary about John Portman's Hyatt Regency Atlanta?
options: A 22-story open atrium lobby that turned the building interior into a dramatic spectacle
